## Summary

Add `awesome-corporate-standards` as a curated reference resource for organizational standards and certification frameworks.

## Why this fits

This repository is aimed at compliance, security, audit, and governance practitioners who need a clean map of standards and frameworks by domain. It complements tooling-focused entries by giving readers a structured reference layer across ISO, NIST, SOC, PCI DSS, GDPR, ESG, financial reporting, and sector-specific standards.
